name: Commuter backpack

baseline.Body dimensions: Approximately 45 × 30 × 17 cm; design choice, not componentwise median
baseline.Organization: Padded laptop compartment, front organizer, key clip, two bottle pockets
baseline.Carry: Padded shoulder straps and back panel
baseline.Fabric: Water-resistant polyester; no waterproof certification claimed
baseline.Warranty: Two years; design choice consistent with tomtoc sample

standout: Removable work organizer: lift out charger, cables, pens, and small essentials together and transfer to another bag. Organizer included.
selling_point: Switch bags without repacking your work essentials.

negative_features.comparison: Heavier than all three sampled bags (650–1,010 g); sample median 900 g.
negative_features.reason: A deliberate weight tradeoff to test against organizer convenience.

negative_features.feature: Laptop sleeve supports up to 15-inch devices; usable compartment 36 × 25 × 2.5 cm (proposed)
negative_features.comparison: Lower claimed diagonal compatibility than tomtoc 15.6-inch and 17.3-inch options; sample median 15.6 inches. Device dimensions still govern fit.
negative_features.reason: A deliberate compatibility limit; not a universal negative for smaller-laptop buyers.

design_notes: Price and capacity equal sample medians. Weight and laptop compatibility deliberately depart below competitiveness. Other categorical specifications are proposed common-feature choices, not computed medians.
research_question: Which purchasing situations prefer this offer over alternatives, and does the marketed feature compensate for the deliberate tradeoffs?
experiments: Same offer with versus without marketed standout
Compare by segment without predetermining launch outcome
